name: crystal-alarm
tagline: A clear, private alarm clock for Android.
intro: A glass-themed alarm clock with a hand-drawn analog face, countdown timer, stopwatch and Material You theming. Everything is stored locally on the phone, and the app requests no internet access at all.
features: Create one-shot or repeating alarms, with any combination of days.
Choose from system alarm, notification or ringtone sounds.
Optional: starts quiet and grows louder over 15 seconds so you wake gently.
Solve a simple math problem before the alarm stops, so you cannot turn it off half-asleep.
The alarm opens a bright full-screen activity even when the phone is locked.
Pomodoro, short break and long break presets plus a custom timer, a circular countdown ring, and pause / resume / add a minute on the fly.
Lap timing with millisecond precision at 20 fps, laps listed newest first.
Radial gradient background, a specular highlight sweeping slowly around the face, a smooth second hand with a counterweight tail, and a digital overlay.
One tap to disable battery optimisation, adjust notification settings, or grant exact alarm permission on Android 14+.

install.title: Build it yourself
install.code:
cd me2008/alarm
./build.sh debug
# APK at app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

install.title: Requirements
install.body: Android SDK 34 and JDK 17. The repo's building guide covers the full setup.

usage.title: Everyday use
usage.body: Add alarms from the clock screen, pick days, a sound and whether you want the volume ramp or the puzzle. The timer and stopwatch live in the same app, and the theme follows your wallpaper colours on Android 12+.

notes: Smart snooze (flip the phone over to snooze) is planned but not implemented yet.
Some settings screens deep-link straight into Android's own battery and notification pages, because only the system can change those.
